---
title: "About"
description: "What Astronomical Intelligence is, its licences, and what data the site collects."
---

Astronomical Intelligence is an open collection of tested workflows, prompts, skills and agent configurations for doing research with language models, started by astronomers and open to every field.

The site is independent of any AI company.

Text is released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) and code under the [MIT licence](https://opensource.org/license/mit).

## Privacy

The site uses no cookies. Visits are counted with [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com), an open-source service that does not track visitors across sites and does not store personal data. Comments on contributions are stored as GitHub Discussions in the site's repository and shown with [giscus](https://giscus.app), which uses no cookies; the comment box is loaded from giscus.app and shows GitHub profile pictures, and writing a comment needs a GitHub account.
